$comment: Stackra file contract: Purpose: the shape of the ROOT runway.yaml, the infrastructure itself. Boundary: shape only; `stackra infra`, `stackra gen`, `stackra dev` and the runway workflows read the file. Member facts live in member runways (runway/app.json, runway/service.json). Runtime: node (editors and validators). Governing contract: ADR 0168 (one schema-validated runway.yaml, its sections), ADR 0169 and ADR 0296 (topology groups), ADR 0170 (environments, release), ADR 0171 (ref: values), ADR 0173 (secrets), ADR 0175 (edge), ADR 0184 (observability), ADR 0238 (one database server per environment), ADR 0237 (gateway secret names), ADR 0299 (the docs destination).
title: runway.yaml (root)
description: The root runway: destinations per environment, shared resources, provider target blocks, the edge, the secrets defaults, the release policy and the defaults members inherit and the topology of each environment (ADR 0168, 0170, 0173, 0296). Members state what they need in their own runway.yaml; the root says where they run and how they are packed. No secret value. `ref:<path>` resolves from the private stacks repo's Pulumi config at infra time (ADR 0171 d4).

$schema.description: The schema reference `stackra validate` reads (`@stackra/runway/schema/root.json`). Editors use the `# yaml-language-server: $schema=` comment instead.

version.description: Runway format version. Version 3 moves placement and sizes into the root topology groups (ADR 0296).

project.description: Prefix for stacks (`<project>/staging`), images (`<project>-core`), Workers and tags.

product.description: The product this repository ships (ADR 0335 d2). A product with no `edition` is a base product; an edition names the base product it is made of and the range of released base versions it accepts.

edition.description: Present when this product is an edition of another.

version.description: Not read yet (STA-339). The semver range of released base manifests the edition is built against.

surfaces.description: The web surfaces the product ships into the OS (or base product) shells, by surface key: console, landing, till, portal and so on, each with its shell line, packages and hosts (ADR 0441 d3, ADR 0436). `ops` is the one OS ops console (D1): a product only contributes to it, declaratively. Runway builds and publishes the bundles and writes the platform `host:` rows.

ops.description: The product's contribution to the one ops console. No shell, packages or host: the OS ships the console, and every ops contribution passes a second-reviewer gate at publish (app-shells 16.7).

contributes.description: A declarative ops contribution: the package that carries it, or the package with its panels, resources and widgets over registered blocks. No component, entry or script (app-shells 16.7).

mobile.description: The mobile apps the product ships from the OS mobile template, by app key (staff, shopper, …): identity, capability flags, store accounts, the EAS project and the per-tenant white-label variants (ADR 0441 d3, ADR 0439).

providers.description: Every account and vendor, named once. Values are public ids or `ref:<path>`; never a secret.
providers.$comment: Typed for the providers whose shape the runway tools rely on; any other provider is an object of ids so a new vendor needs no schema change.

aws.description: AWS accounts, Pulumi state, ECR and cost controls.

account.description: Opt-in (ADR 0524): figentra/infra vends the product's one AWS account only when true, in the regions of its me and eu environments.

region.description: Deprecated: use `environments.<env>.region` (ADR 0524); `runway validate` warns for one release. The one region (ADR 0186).

accounts.description: Deprecated: the three accounts (shared, nonprod, prod) no longer match ADR 0524; a product has one AWS account holding all its regions, which figentra/infra resolves as `ref:aws.account`. `runway validate` warns for one release. Account role → account id or `ref:`.

state.description: Pulumi state: the S3 bucket and KMS key (ADR 0171 d4).

ecr.description: Not read yet (Runway plan PR 12, STA-2001). Image registry: the owning account and the scan, SBOM and signing tools.

budgets.description: Cost alerts: the monthly cap, percentage thresholds and the point non-production stops.

monthlyUsd.description: The monthly budget in US dollars figentra/infra sets on the product's one account; the thresholds are percentages of it. Deprecated: a record per account role (`nonprod`, `prod`, each a number or `ref:`), the three-account layout; `runway validate` warns for one release.

gcp.description: Google Cloud projects and Pulumi state (ADR 0354).

projects.description: Project role → project id or `ref:`, or an object such as `{ id, number }` that infra-gcp checks (ADR 0401).

project.description: Opt-in (ADR 0524): figentra/infra vends the product's one GCP project only when true. An environment in `ksa` needs it.

apis.description: The Google services figentra/infra enables in the product's project.

state.description: Not read yet (Runway plan PR 16, STA-2001). Pulumi state for the GCP stacks.

cloudflare.description: Cloudflare account, DNS zones (ADR 0175) and the non-Worker DNS records figentra/infra writes.

zones.description: Zone name → zone id or `ref:`, or an object with the id and, for the one root runway that owns the zone, its plan and policy (ADR 0519). Member runways name hosts under these zones.

owner.description: True in exactly one root runway per zone; every other repository only reads the id. An owner states its plan.

plan.description: The Cloudflare plan, which decides what the policy may ask for.

policy.description: Zone preset, set by the owner only: baseline (SSL strict, TLS 1.3, HSTS, DNSSEC, CAA), or strict (plus bot protection, needs plan: pro).

records.description: Non-Worker DNS records (verification TXT, MX, CAA). Worker hosts stay in wrangler and Runway (ADR 0519). Each `name` is a full host name under a `zones` entry.

name.description: The full host name, lower case (`_dmarc.pay.figentra.com`).

content.description: The record's value, as Cloudflare stores it.

proxied.description: Through Cloudflare's proxy; only A, AAAA and CNAME.

topics.description: The repository's GitHub topics: the base set for its type first, then its domain topics (ADR 0534).

homepage.description: The repository's homepage: the live docs site, else the live product site (ADR 0534).

github.description: The GitHub repository and its environments (ADR 0468). Closed: a misspelt key fails. infra-github reads it.

npm.description: Where the repository's packages publish (ADR 0453 decision 6); the release workflow's `registry` input carries it.

registry.description: The npm-compatible registry URL, ending in /.

scope.description: The npm scope the repository publishes (never renamed, ADR 0453).

additionalProperties.description: Another vendor: public ids or `ref:` values.

regions.description: Every data region, named once: its cloud, cloud region, account or project, and jurisdiction (ADR 0354 d4). Environments list the regions they deploy to.

environments.description: Per-environment destinations, shared resources and member defaults. Exactly these four names in every tool (ADR 0170 DP5; `local` is `dev`).

resources.description: Managed resources the product's runtime needs, by name, provisioned per environment in the product's account (ADR 0493).

workloads.description: Container workloads (ECS Fargate) for servers no managed option fits, by name (ADR 0493 d5).

targets.description: Provider settings per destination, selected by `environments.<env>.destinations.*`. The destinations Runway knows are closed (a misspelt key fails); another destination name stays open. Each provider still checks its own settings.

encore-cloud.description: Encore Cloud: the cloud of the linked account.

workflows.description: Caller workflows `pnpm runway deploy|promote` dispatches, by member or purpose.

customDomains.description: Hosts served as Workers Custom Domains, rendered as wrangler `routes` with `custom_domain: true` (ADR 0519).

members.description: Worker members; the provider checks each.

workflows.description: Caller workflows `pnpm runway deploy|promote` dispatches, by member or purpose.

npm.description: Package publishing to the Stackra registry.

workflows.description: Caller workflows `pnpm runway deploy|promote` dispatches, by member or purpose.

edge.description: The edge (ADR 0175). Closed: a misspelt key fails. infra-cloudflare reads it with its own defaults.

secrets.description: Secret defaults. Secret NAMES are declared by members (ADR 0168 d5, 0257); values live in figentra/secrets as sops files, scope `products/<project>/<env>` (ADR 0525).

sync.description: When runway copies the values the deploy job decrypted (.github/actions/secrets-decrypt) into the runtimes (Encore, Workers, EAS, compose, Kubernetes).

defaultPath.description: Deprecated and ignored (ADR 0525): it named a `providers.infisical.paths` key. `runway validate` warns for one release; remove it.

ci.description: CI-only secret names the release workflows read over OIDC; never given to a runtime.

gateway.description: Runtime secret names the generated API gateway reads (ADR 0237). The gateway belongs to no member, so its names sit here.

release.description: The release policy. Closed: a misspelt key fails. Only `buildOrder` is read today.

alerts.description: The alarms figentra/infra sets in the product's account (the design of 2026-11-06). Every key is optional and takes infra-observability's default; `enabled: false` turns one off.

environments.description: The environments alarmed; staging and production by default.

latencyP95.description: Fires when p95 latency exceeds `threshold` ms (default 1000, 10m, warning).

dbCpu.description: Fires when database CPU exceeds `threshold` % (default 80, 15m, warning).

dbConnections.description: Fires when database connections exceed `threshold` % of the maximum (default 80, 10m, warning).

dbFreeStorage.description: Fires when free database storage falls below `threshold` % (default 20, 15m, critical).

cacheMemory.description: Fires when cache memory exceeds `threshold` % (default 80, 15m, warning).

cacheEvictions.description: Fires when cache evictions exceed `threshold` per minute (default 0, 15m, warning).

budget.description: Budget notifications at these percentages of `providers.aws.budgets.monthlyUsd` (default 80 forecast, 100 actual).

notify.description: Where each severity goes. A route is `oncall` (Better Stack), `email:<address>`, `slack:<channel id>` (AWS Chatbot needs the id) or `linear:<team key>`. Critical pages on-call by default.

observability.description: Observability (ADR 0184). Closed: a misspelt key fails. infra-observability reads it with its own defaults.

alert.description: One metric alert; its direction against the threshold is fixed per alert.

region.description: One data region: the cloud and cloud region that serve it (ADR 0354 d4, ADR 0353).

account.description: The AWS account or GCP project that holds it, or `ref:` (one AWS account per product-region, ADR 0354 d2).

jurisdiction.description: The jurisdiction its data stays in, for residency evidence.

value.description: A public value, or `ref:<path>` resolved from the stacks repo at infra time (ADR 0171 d4).

destination.description: Where a kind of member runs. Each name has a block under `targets`.

resources.description: Compute size and scaling of one process.

memory.description: Memory per instance, in Mi or Gi.

metric.description: Not read yet (Runway plan PR 12, STA-2001). Metric that drives scaling.

target.description: Not read yet (Runway plan PR 12, STA-2001). Target value of the metric, in percent for cpu.

topology.description: How the service members of this environment are packed into processes (ADR 0296 d2). In a grouped environment every service member is placed in exactly one group; `stackra validate` checks that.

mode.description: One process for every service, named groups, or one process per service.

isolate.description: Members that keep their own database server and network policy (ADR 0296 d2). A member runway cannot undo it.

default.description: The group of every service member no group lists. Without it, an unplaced member fails `stackra validate`.

groups.description: Group name → its members and size. Each group is a process allocation inside the one generated Encore app (ADR 0296 d3).

group.description: One process allocation: the members it runs, their size and where their background work runs.

members.description: The service member keys this group runs.

memory.description: Not read yet (Runway plan PR 12, STA-2001). Memory per instance, in Mi or Gi.

min.description: Not read yet (Runway plan PR 12, STA-2001). Fewest instances kept running.

scaling.description: Not read yet (Runway plan PR 12, STA-2001). Autoscaling rule.

workers.description: Not read yet (Runway plan PR 12, STA-2001). Background work (queues, crons, the outbox relay) of this group's members.

split.description: Not read yet (Runway plan PR 12, STA-2001). Run background work in its own process, which scales apart from request handling.

cpu.description: Not read yet (Runway plan PR 12, STA-2001). vCPUs per instance.

memory.description: Not read yet (Runway plan PR 12, STA-2001). Memory per instance, in Mi or Gi.

instances.description: Not read yet (Runway plan PR 12, STA-2001). Instance count bounds.

min.description: Not read yet (Runway plan PR 12, STA-2001). Fewest instances kept running.

environment.description: One environment of the root runway.

destinations.description: Where each kind of member runs. A member runway may override its own.

infra.description: Dev only: the containers `stackra dev` brings (gateway, postgres, valkey, minio, zitadel, mailpit, otel-lgtm). A driver set to `memory` in every service removes its container.

additionalProperties.description: One container: image, ports and when it starts.

lanes.description: Dev only: lane N adds N × `portStep` to every dev port, member and infra. Lane = repository index × `worktrees` + worktree; `stackra validate` computes every effective port over the table and fails on a duplicate (STA-863).

from.description: Not read yet (Runway plan PR 8, STA-2001). Environment variable holding the lane number.

repos.description: The repository index table, in one place: repository key to index; no two share an index.

https.description: Dev only: a local CA and `<key>.localhost` names behind one proxy.

proxy.description: Not read yet (Runway plan PR 8, STA-2001). Dev only: routes by Host to member dev ports; needed only for `*.localhost` or https.

encore.description: Encore Cloud environment name, account and process allocation (`from-topology`: one allocation per topology group).

ttl.description: Not read yet (Runway plan PR 16, STA-2001). Preview only: how long a per-pull-request environment lives.

data.description: Preview only: which data a preview gets.

limits.description: The plan's monthly estimate cap in US dollars; with none the plan only warns (ADR 0493 d3).

tier.description: The size the environment runs at, from the finance tiers (the cost plan of 2026-11-06): its compute, database, cache and NAT defaults (`TIER_SIZES`). Production defaults to `launch`, every other environment to `staging`; the `shared` keys below override it.

shared.description: Resources shared by every member: ONE database server per environment (ADR 0238 d1), the cache cluster, the queue provider, networking and bucket defaults.

natGateways.description: NAT gateways for outbound internet; the tier's count when absent.

database.description: The Postgres server: engine, class, storage, Multi-AZ, backups, extensions and pooling. The typed keys override the tier; Encore Cloud applies them from its dashboard, and `runway plan` reports drift.

class.description: An RDS instance class (db.t4g.medium), or a Cloud SQL tier on ksa.

multiAz.description: Whether a standby runs in a second zone.

storageGb.description: Allocated storage in GB (RDS starts at 20).

cache.description: The cache cluster: engine, node type and replicas. The typed keys override the tier. In `me`, `runway validate` refuses a t4g or m6g node class, which me-central-1 does not offer.

mode.description: Valkey serverless, or fixed nodes of one class.

queues.description: The queue provider and dead-letter default.

buckets.description: Defaults for every member bucket: versioning and lifecycle.

defaults.description: Defaults every member of that kind inherits in this environment.

service.description: Service member defaults. Placement is `topology.default` and sizes live in the topology groups (ADR 0296).

database.description: Defaults of every service's logical database (ADR 0238).

poolBudget.description: Database connections one service may hold on the shared server unless its runway says otherwise (ADR 0238).

config.description: The config layer every service starts from in this environment, keyed by config key, driver choices included (ADR 0146, 0296 d1). A member runway's `config` overrides one key.

app.description: App member defaults (dev server flags, Workers observability).

region.description: The tenant region this environment lives in (OS 0001): `me` (AWS me-central-1), `eu` (AWS eu-central-1) or `ksa` (GCP me-central2). Required on staging and production of a product runway (`runway validate`). figentra/infra places the environment in that region of the product's one account (`ref:aws.account`, ADR 0524). Distinct from `regions`, the deploy order across the root `regions` entries.

regions.description: The regions this environment deploys to, by key of the root `regions`, in release order (a release rolls region by region).

domains.description: How member hosts are named in this environment.

pattern.description: Not read yet (Runway plan PR 16, STA-2001). Host pattern; `${member}` and `${pr}` are expanded.

tenantDomains.description: Not read yet (Runway plan PR 16, STA-2001). How tenant custom domains are served.

deploy.description: What triggers a deploy and what gates it (ADR 0170).

on.description: Trigger: each pull request, each merge to main, or `runway promote <sha>`.

gate.description: Deprecated: an alias of `release.gate`. Not read yet (Runway plan PR 13, STA-2001). Post-deploy gate (DP24).

cloud.description: Deprecated (ADR 0524): an environment's `region` fixes its cloud, and the product's one account or project is `providers.aws.account` or `providers.gcp.project`; `runway validate` warns for one release.

dedicated.description: Dedicated deployments of this environment's services: one tenant each, in its own account or project, released with the environment (ADR 0400).

cloud.description: The cloud an environment's foundation runs on and the account or project that holds it (ADR 0354 d4, ADR 0400). It replaces `providers.gcp.environments`.

dedicated.description: One dedicated deployment: one tenant, its own account or project, the environment's release train (ADR 0400).

tenant.description: The tenant id the deployment serves; never a name.

regions.description: The regions it runs in, by key of the root `regions`; the environment's when absent.

encore.description: Encore Cloud settings of its own app environment (the branch it deploys from).

assetPath.description: A path inside the root `assets/` tree; no segment starts with a dot (ADR 0441 d1 and enforcement).

shellLine.description: A shell or template line, `<owner>/<shell>@<major>` (ADR 0436, ADR 0439).

surface.description: One web surface: the shell line, an optional preset, the product packages it loads, its host or hosts, and a landing site's seed content.

preset.description: A shell preset, such as `portal` (a console variant, D11).

packages.description: The product packages the shell loads through its import map.

host.description: The platform host label; Runway writes its `host:` row.

hosts.description: Further hosts serving the same surface; at most one is canonical for search engines (D2).

content.description: A landing site's seed experience documents, imported once (ADR 0440).

contribution.description: A declarative ops contribution: the package that carries it, or the package with its panels, resources and widgets over registered blocks. No component, entry or script (app-shells 16.7).

package.description: The package that carries the contribution.

contributionEntry.description: One panel, resource or widget: a key, the registered block it renders and data props.

block.description: A registered block id, never a module path or an export.

whiteLabel.description: Per-tenant build variants, started by an OS event: the entitlement that turns them on and the publishing modes (D14).

entitlement.description: The entitlement key (`<module>.<name>`, snake_case) a scope must hold for a white-label build; the mobile job refuses the build without it.

mobileApp.description: One mobile app built from the OS template line.

assets.description: Icon, adaptive icon, splash and notification icon sources.

store.description: Store listing text, keywords, screenshots and privacy answers per locale.

links.description: App-link hosts; Runway writes their `wellknown:` rows.

capabilities.description: The template's capability flags this app turns on; the build strips the rest (ADR 0439).

signIn.description: Sign-in this app offers. An iOS app that lists any social provider must list apple too (App Store guideline 4.8, STA-1578); with apple the build adds the com.apple.developer.applesignin entitlement.

social.description: The social sign-in providers, @stackra/identity's externalProviders keys; a national ID service is not social and is not listed.

resource.description: One managed resource. kafka, opensearch and ses are reserved kinds (ADR 0493 d5).

size.description: A size per environment; an environment not named runs small (ADR 0493 d3).

workload.description: One container workload; reason is required (ADR 0493 d5). A public workload needs a port and a health path; a health path needs a port; an internal worker may have neither.

healthCommand.description: A worker's own health check: the command the container runs, healthy when it exits 0.

command.description: The container's arguments, replacing the image's default command.

migrate.description: A one-off task run with the same image, env, secrets and resources before each rollout; the rollout waits for it and stops when it fails.

command.description: The migration task's arguments, replacing the image's default command.

timeoutMinutes.description: How long the rollout waits for the task; 15 when absent.

expose.description: public puts an ALB behind Cloudflare in front; internal is service discovery only.

uses.description: The resources it uses, by name.

env.description: Public values only; a secret goes in secrets.

aliases.description: The name the image reads, mapped to a variable of a resource it uses (ADR 0493 d4).

size.description: A size per environment; an environment not named runs small (ADR 0493 d3).
